searchText: Hi, apologies if I'm in wrong channel, but in the EEST repo's readme (https://github.com/ethereum/execution-spec-tests#prerequisites) its mentioned to go with `uv` but on the site (https://ethereum.github.io/execution-spec-tests/v3.0.0/getting_started/quick_start/) its handling everything with `pip` ?? Looks like the docs are outdated, you should use `uv` 🙂 Follow these steps instead: https://github.com/ethereum/execution-spec-tests?tab=readme-ov-file#getting-started Note: this will also depend on what commit you have checked out the repo 🙂 CC <@755913785620824175> I think the docs need to be updated 🙂
